payload.rationale: The inventory-controller ServiceAccount is bound via RoleBinding to Role 'inventory-settings-reader' in namespace 'proofix-case-09'. The Role currently only permits 'get' on 'pods', omitting 'get' and 'list' permissions on 'configmaps'. This causes the controller's HTTP requests to fetch 'inventory-settings' ConfigMap to fail with 403 Forbidden. Updating the Role rules to grant 'get' and 'list' verbs on 'configmaps' resolves the authorization deficit.
payload.rollback_trigger: The controller continues to encounter RBAC authorization errors or 5xx error rates exceed SLO limits.

success_criteria.description: The inventory-controller successfully queries the inventory-settings ConfigMap and reconciles with HTTP 200 responses, maintaining error rate < 0.001 and p95 latency < 200ms.

critical_claims.claim: Role 'inventory-settings-reader' in namespace 'proofix-case-09' defines rules only for resource 'pods' with verb 'get', lacking rules for 'configmaps'.
RoleBinding 'inventory-settings-reader' binds ServiceAccount 'inventory-controller' in namespace 'proofix-case-09' to Role 'inventory-settings-reader'.
InventoryServer.java queries 'https://<apiserver>/api/v1/namespaces/proofix-case-09/configmaps/inventory-settings' using the mounted ServiceAccount token.
Pod 'inventory-controller-d468c8cfc-4m574' runs under ServiceAccount 'inventory-controller' and is in Running state with Ready condition True.
Patching Role 'inventory-settings-reader' successfully resolved the issue with subsequent SLO samples meeting error rate and latency thresholds.

closure.summary: Root cause hypothesis hyp-rbac-missing-configmap-verbs identified: Role 'inventory-settings-reader' granted permissions on pods instead of configmaps, causing 403 Forbidden errors when inventory-controller queried the inventory-settings ConfigMap. The deficit was remediated by patching the Role to grant configmap access, verified by consecutive healthy SLO evaluation windows.
